entities.summary: Jesse James Rodriguez Franco is an American professional boxer. He has held multiple world championships in two weight classes, including the unified World Boxing Association (WBA), World Boxing Council (WBC), World Boxing Organization (WBO), and Ring magazine super flyweight titles since November 2025. He previously held the WBC super flyweight title in 2022 and the unified International Boxing Federation (IBF) and WBO flyweight titles from 2023 to 2024.
